in_marathi.name: Ranvijay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ran: Rule, Vijay: Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranvijay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ranvijay is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a combination of two words, 'Ran' meaning rule and 'Vijay' meaning victory. This name signifies a person who rules with victory and triumph in life. In Hindu mythology, Ranvijay is the name of various deities and warrior heroes who have achieved victory in their respective fields.
